column1: # CNC Tool Monitor — 16 MB flash partition layout
# Budget rationale (SRS HW-D2):
#   Dual OTA is mandatory for safe rollback (OTA-R2)
#   slot. The web UI assets live in their own read-only LittleFS partition so
#   they can be updated independently of the firmware (OTA-R4).
# No `logs` partition: on-device data logging (LG-R1…R7) has been dropped —
# flash budget doesn't support holding a useful amount of history
# 5-minute RAM trend buffer (trend.c) covers the "what just happened" case
# this device actually needs. If durable history is wanted later
# off-device (Modbus/MQTT to a PLC or historian)
# Name        Type  SubType   Offset     Size       Notes
# The generator only accepts whole-line comments (a line starting with #)
# not a trailing note after real fields — anything past the Size column on
# a data line is parsed as the Flags field. So notes live on the line above
# rather than at the end of each row.
nvs
otadata
phy_init
# calibration + serial
factory_cal
# 2 MB
ota_0
# 2 MB
ota_1
# 512 KB gzipped SPA (UI-R2 budget 250 KB). Everything past this to the end
# of flash (~11.4 MB) is presently unallocated.
web
